metadata.description: A development pipeline for Claude Code: the session you started orchestrates, Sonnet implementers build a one-screen plan, the machine checks it, you approve and finish.

plugins.name: dev-skills
plugins.description: Seven stages at every size: a grill or a discussion, an offered prototype, a one-screen plan, implementers run by the plan's graph, the E2E gate (review and e2e at once), a human gate that approves, and finish. The session you started orchestrates and never edits code; the plugin ships no hooks and no scripts.
